Title: Denmark – Software package and information systems – Hardware and Software for NemLog-in CA component
Procedure title: Hardware and Software for NemLog-in CA component
Description: The Contracting Authority, the Danish Agency for Digital Government (Digitaliseringsstyrelsen), operates on behalf of the Danish State a national qualified and non-qualified trust service under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 (eIDAS2). As part of continuing the existing trust service, the Contracting Authority is undertaking procurement of three separate lots/contracts for the software and hardware components required. The procurement comprises three individual lots/contracts: Lot 1 for Contract for CA and OSCP Software, Lot 2 for Contract for Utimaco HSMs for CA operation, and Lot 3 for Contract TSA Software. Full details of the individual contracts and the associated requirements are contained in the procurement documents.
Lot description: The Contracting Authority operates on behalf of the Danish State a national qualified and non-qualified trust service under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 (eIDAS2). As part of continuing the existing trust service on a new software platform, the Contracting Authority is procuring Certification Authority (CA) Software to be installed and operated on-premise in the Contracting Authority's data centres (currently two). The Contract covers the delivery of Standard Software, including Licences, Documentation and support necessary to operate CA and Validation Authority (VA) functionality as part of the Contracting Authority's trust services. The Software must integrate with the Contracting Authority's existing infrastructure, including HSMs, registration authority components, signing services, directory services and monitoring infrastructure, and must support the migration of the existing EJBCA-based CA environment while preserving certificate, revocation and audit-log integrity. The Supplier's principal obligations comprise: (a) the Delivery of Standard Software for development, test, staging and production environments, including the required software-only configuration for development and test; (b) Ongoing Services, including support and maintenance of the Standard Software and security patching; (c) Ordered Services, comprising Time-Based Services (services for installation, configuration, key ceremonies, and similar tasks); and (d) Cross-cutting Services, comprising Documentation and security, provided as an integral part of the Ongoing Services and Ordered Services throughout the term of the Contract. The Contracting Authority operates on behalf of the Danish State a national qualified and non-qualified trust service under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 (eIDAS2). As part of continuing the existing trust service on a new software platform, the Contracting Authority is procuring Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) for CA operation to be installed and operated on-premise in the Contracting Authority's data centres (currently two). The lot covers the delivery of HSM, including the required client software, HSM simulator, smartcards, Documentation and support necessary to operate root CA and legacy issuing CA functionality as part of the Contracting Authority's trust services. The HSMs must integrate with the Contracting Authority's existing infrastructure, including KeyFactor EJBCA, monitoring infrastructure and associated operational processes, and must support the secure migration of the existing root CA and legacy issuing CA signing keys at cryptographic-module level while preserving the certification status and verifiability of the key material. The Supplier's principal obligations comprise: (a) the Delivery of Hardware, including associated client software, sized and configured for operation across two data centres in an active/active configuration, together with deployment in the Contracting Authority's production, staging, and test environments; (b) Ongoing Services, including support and maintenance of the Hardware, security patching, and technology refresh of Hardware during the term of the Contract to maintain valid certifications; (c) Ordered Services, comprising Time-Based Services (services for installation, configuration, key ceremonies, and similar tasks) and Options and (d) Cross-cutting Services, comprising Documentation and security, provided as an integral part of the Ongoing Services and Ordered Services throughout the term of the Contract. The Contracting Authority operates on behalf of the Danish State a national qualified and non-qualified trust service under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 (eIDAS2). As part of continuing the existing trust service on a new software platform, the Contracting Authority is procuring Timestamping Authority (TSA) Software to be installed and operated on-premise in the Contracting Authority's data centres (currently two). The lot covers the delivery of Standard Software, including Licences, Documentation and support and maintenance services necessary to operate TSA functionality as part of the Contracting Authority's trust services. The Software must integrate with the Contracting Authority's existing infrastructure, including HSMs, signing services and monitoring infrastructure, and must support the migration of the existing TSA service while preserving the qualified status and verifiability of historical timestamping records. The Supplier's principal obligations comprise: (a) the Delivery of Standard Software for development, test, staging and production environments, including the required software-only configuration for development and test; (b) Ongoing Services, including support and maintenance of the Standard Software and security patching; (c) Ordered Services, comprising Time-Based Services (services for installation, configuration, key ceremonies, and similar tasks); and (d) Cross-cutting Services, comprising Documentation and security, provided as an integral part of the Ongoing Services and Ordered Services throughout the term of the Contract.

Title: Germany – Cleaning services – Gebäudereinigung - Stadt Nideggen
Procedure title: Gebäudereinigung - Stadt Nideggen
Description: Ausgeschrieben werden Unterhalts- und Glas-/Rahmenreinigungsleistungen in Objekten der Stadt Nideggen. Die Leistungen fallen in zwei Losen an. Die Aufteilung der Lose ist unter mengenmäßigen, örtlichen und fachlichen Gesichtspunkten erfolgt. Details zu Intervallen, Arten und Umfängen der zu erbringenden Leistungen sind der Leistungsbeschreibung nebst Anlagen insbesondere den Preisblättern zu entnehmen. Der Auftraggeber behält sich vor, die zu reinigenden Flächen und Intervalle ohne neues Vergabeverfahren im Rahmen des § 132 GWB Abs. 2 bis 4 zu erhöhen und/oder zu reduzie-ren. Die Abgabe von Angeboten kann für ein Los, mehrere oder alle Lose erfolgen. Innerhalb der Lose sind jedoch alle Objekte mit allen Einzelleistungen anzubieten. Die Vergabe der Leistungen erfolgt je Los. Die Einzelvergabe von Objekten ist nicht vorgesehen.
Lot description: Los 1 umfasst Unterhaltsreinigungen. Die Objekte verfügen über eine Grundfläche von ca. 16.000 m². Die jährliche Reinigungsfläche beträgt ca. 2.000.000 m². Los 2 umfasst Glas-/Rahmenreinigung. Die Objekte verfügen über eine Grundfläche von ca. 5.000 m² (lichtes Rohbaumaß, einseitig gemessen). Die Flächen sind in der Regel zweimal jährlich beidseitig inkl. Rahmen zu reinigen sofern nicht explizit etwas anderes angegeben ist.
